tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: phyag rdor gtum po'i las byang gnam lcags 'od kyi drwa ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈ dus gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i dpal: gsang bdag dregs pa mthar byed kyi: sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo: gsang sngags phrin gzhung kun gyi mchog: yang gsang sgrub pa'i las byang ni: bdag 'dra pad+ma thod phreng gis: gnam lcags 'od kyi drwa ba bkod: ye shes mtsho rgyal nyid la gnang: snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum: dang po sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bka' bsgo zhing: mtshams bcad brda' sgo dbye ba dang: mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab dang drug: dngos gzhi'i las rim drug pa ni: gzhal yas lha bskyed spyan 'dren zhing: bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul dang: 'dzab bsnyen bzlas dang las rim drug: rjes kyi las rim drug pa ni: bstod pa tshogs 'bul lhag mchod gtong: bskul pa chad mdo brtan ma skyong: rjes kyi las rim drug pa 'o: las kyi rim pa bco brgyad kyi: rjes su 'gro ba'i las rim ni: rta bro bsdu chog bkra shis smon lam bya: de la dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: hūm̐: dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang: sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: dkyil 'khor lha dang chos skyong sogs: bdag sogs 'gro kun skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun don du: nges pa'i don du sems bskyed nas: bla med gsang sngags 'di bsgrub pas: bdag gzhan bla med yongs 'grub shog: ces pas sems bskyed: gsum pa bka' bsgo ba ni: bgegs gtor phyir 'bul la: bdag nyid gsang bdag bsgoms pa'i nga rgyal gyis 'di skad do: hūm̐: bdag nyid gsang bdag thugs khros pas: gnod byed 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs: khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum po: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed: de bas bgegs gtor 'di khyer la: 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: oṃ sum bha ni sum bha hūm̐:= ces bka' bsgo:

bzhi pa mtshams gcad pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir: bdag nyid gsang bdag thugs ka nas: 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang mthing: 'od zer dkar po'i 'phro 'du las: steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la: 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur: phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i rtsig pa ste: bar na rdo rje glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed rdo rje'i rwa la bskyon: rdo rje gsor bas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer ser po'i 'phro 'du las: steng yang phur pa'i bla bre la: 'og kyang phur pa'i sa gzhir gyur: phyogs mtshams phur pa'i rtsig pa ste: bar na phur pa glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed phur pa'i dbal la bskyon: phur pa 'dril bas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer dmar po'i 'phro 'du las: steng yang gri gug bla bre la: 'og kyang gri gug sa gzhir gyur: phyogs mtshams gri gug rtsig pa ste: bar na gri gug glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed gri gug rtse la bskyon: gri gug 'bar bas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra phe laṃ rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer ljang gu'i 'phro 'du las: steng yang ral gri'i bla re la: 'og kyang ral gri'i sa gzhir gyur: phyogs mtshams ral gri'i rtsig pa ste: bar na ral gri glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed ral gri'i so la bskyon: ral gri 'bar bas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra shang kar na rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: 'od zer mthing ga'i 'phro 'du las: steng yang 'khor lo'i bla bre la: 'og kyang 'khor lo'i sa gzhir gyur: phyogs mtshams 'khor lo'i rtsig pa ste: bar na 'khor lo glog ltar 'gyu: gnod byed 'khor lo'i rtsibs la bskyon: 'khor lo 'bar bas mtshams chod cig: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa: mtshon cha sna lnga 'khrugs pa la: ye shes me phung dmar nag 'bar: 'ur 'ur chem chem me sgra ste: me yi tshwa tshwa tha ra ra: gnod byed 'byung po'i snying rtsa sreg: oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭa:

hūm̐: gnod byed mi min bgegs kyi tshogs: gsang bdag bka' las 'da' ma byed: gsang bdag bka' las 'da' byed na: rdo rje gsor ba'i rwa la bskyon: phur pa 'dril ba'i dbal la bskyon: gri gug rnon po'i rtse la bskyon: ral gri 'bar ba'i so la bskyon: 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon: me 'obs chen po'i nang du bsreg: khro chu khol ma'i nang du bskyur: ri rab chen po'i rmang 'og mnan: chu srin gdug pa'i mgrin par brdzang: de bas dam la ma 'da' bar: gnod byed tshogs rnams phyir dengs shig: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa 'byung po u tsa ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas mtshams bcad do: brda' sgo dbye zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag gzhal yas khang: gzugs snang thams cad gsang bdag sku: gnyis 'dzin log ltas sgo bcad pas: rang gsal snying po'i brda' sgo phye: bh+rūm̐ pra we sha ya phaṭa: rang rig skye med chos kyi sku: ye nas rang dang gnyis med pa'i: rang ngo ma shes gzung 'dzin 'thas: rang gsal dag phyir phyag 'tshal lo: na mo pū ru sha ya ho: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang: gnyis 'dzin dbang gis so sor phyes: rang dang dbyer med gcig pa la: srog gi phyir yang mi gtong bsgrub: oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐: lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: swa bhā wa bi shud+dho sa stong par sbyang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+yā shab+da hūm̐: oṃ ma hā kiṃ ni ri ti hūm̐: oṃ bho dhi tsit+ta ga na gu h+ya hūm̐: oṃ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐: oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐: oṃ ma hā ba lin ta hūm̐: zhes mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab bo: de nas gzhal yas dang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams rang bzhin spros dang bral: nam mkha' lta bu'i rang bzhin las: 'gro drug kun la khyab pa yi: brtse ba'i snying rje nyi ltar bsgom: stong nyid snying rje gsal ba'i klong: rgyu yi rig pa hūm̐ du gsal:

de las 'od 'phros 'byung rim brtsegs: e yaṃ raṃ ra suṃ kiṃ bh+rūm̐: e skye med stong pa'i mkha' dbyings las: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yos: raṃ las me phung dmar nag 'bar: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil: suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal: kiṃ las rus pa'i ri rab steng: bh+rūm̐ las dur khrod gzhal yas khang: thod pa skam rlon rtsigs pa byas: lha chen ka brgyad rngams shing 'gying: rus sbal ka gdan mkhun pa 'debs: gza' brgyad ka zhu glog ltar 'gyu: lha brgyad klu brgyad gdung ma gdung 'degs dang: rgyu skar nyer brgyad gral phyam byas: zhing chen thog phub thod pa'i bad: rgyu ma'i drwa phyed spras pa la: tsit+ta'i pho long dmar chen brgyan: mi ro'i rgyal mtshan kiṃ rus 'phan: rtse na gnam lcags phyogs bcur gdengs: rdo rje'i ya them ma them dang: g.yas g.yon re bzhi byas pa las: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i sgo mo la: rdo rje nyi zla'i yag shing bcas: mi 'gyur ur mo'i gzer gyis bsdams: pho brang rab tu yangs pa'i nang: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong: mthing nag gru gsum e dkyil steng: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma'i khar: gza' brgyad klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng: bdag nyid gsang bdag phyag rdor ni: mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: phyag g.yas gnam lcags rdo rje gsor: phyag g.yon dug sbrul zhal du khyer: zhal ni bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs: spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs gyen thur g.yo: sma ra kha spu me stag 'phro: smin ma rab 'jigs glog ltar 'gyu: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil: rigs bdag sangs rgyas mi bskyod bzhugs: thod pa'i dbu rgyan prog zhu gsol: sku stod seng glang g.yang gzhi gsol: smad dkris stag gi sham thabs byas: thod pa skam rlon do shal dang: sbrul chun se ral kha yis brgyan: dga' bo 'jog po'i thod bcings shing: 'dab bzang dkar po'i sku regs byas: klu rigs bzhi yis phyag zhabs brgyan:

sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs tshul can: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'dor thabs bsgrad: me phung klong na 'gying tshul bzhugs: phrin las sprul pa'i khyung chen lnga: bdag nyid gsang bdag spyi gtsug na: gti mug 'joms pa'i khyung chen mthing la khro: bdag nyid gsang bdag dpung pa g.yas steng na: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i khyung chen ser la khro: bdag nyid gsang bdag dpung pa g.yon steng na: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i khyung chen sngo la khro: bdag nyid gsang bdag pus gong g.yas steng na: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i khyung chen dmar la khro: bdag nyid gsang bdag pus gong g.yon steng na: phrag dog 'joms pa'i khyung chen ljang la khro: phrin las sprul pa'i khyung chen rigs lnga ni: gnam lcags rdo rje'i mchu la glog gi lce: spyan gsum dmar 'khrugs khrag gi rba klong 'khrugs: g.yu yi smin ma bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: lcags rwa nag po dud pa phyu ru ru: spyi gtsug nor bu dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs: 'dab gshog gdengs pas gnam sa 'khrug cing g.yo: sder mo 'dzin pas klu rnams pho nyar 'gyed: rin chen spu gseb gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs: dug sbrul zhal khyer sde brgyad srog snying za: las mkhan khro bcus bar chad 'byung po 'dul: sgo srung bzhi yis skal med bgegs rnams bsrung: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ga ru ḍa ma hā rak+ṣa sa ma ya hūm̐: zhes gzhal yas lha bskyed: spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: 'gags med gzugs sku khros pa'i skur ston pa: gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ni: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong nas bzhengs: nga rgyal 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i klong nas bzhengs: 'dod chags khrag gi rgya mtsho'i klong nas bzhengs: phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: gti mug mun ltar 'thibs pa'i klong nas bzhengs: 'og min gnas nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

lcang lo can nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnam lcags rtse nas spyan 'dren= gsang bdag phyag rdor spyan 'dren= 'phags pa gos sngon spyan 'dren= dregs pa kun 'dul spyan 'dren= rdo rje gtum po spyan 'dren= steng gdon gza' rnams 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= 'og gdon klu rnams 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= sman dang ma mo 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= bdud dang srin po 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= rgyal 'gong dkor bdag 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= the'u rang dam sri 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= sde brgyad 'byung po 'dul phyir spyan 'dren= mkha' lding khyung lnga spyan 'dren= khro bo bcu yi lha tshogs spyan 'dren= sgo ma bzhi rnams spyan 'dren= gter bdag bka' nyan tshogs rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: zhes spyan 'dren: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag dur khrod gzhal yas khang: ye shes me phung dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba e dkyil steng: thabs shes nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khar: gza' brgyad klu brgyad dregs pa bsnol ba'i khar: bcom ldan gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs su gsol: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: zhes bzhugs su gsol: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa'i sku: gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje ni: phyi nang gsang ba'i gtso 'khor ma lus la: sgo gsum gus pas lus ngag yid phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya ho: phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: gzugs kyi lha mo puṣ+pe ma: sku la na bza' dkar khra gsol: phyag na mdzes pa'i me tog bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes nas spyan la thim: sgra yi lha mo gan+dhe ma: sku la na bza' ser khra gsol: phyag gnyis gar bsgyur pi waṃ bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes nas snyan la thim:

dri yi lha mo bdug spos ma: sku la na bza' dmar khra gsol: phyag na bdug pa'i spos me bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes nas shangs la thim: ro yi lha mo nīrti ma: sku la na bza' ljang khra gsol: phyag gnyis gar bsgyur zhal zas bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes nas ljags la thim: reg bya'i lha mo na bza' ma: sku la na bza' mthing ber gsol: phyag gnyis gar bsgyur lhab lhub bsnams: rgyal ba mnyes nas sku la thim: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: phyi yi mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'gro ba'i don du bzhes nas kyang: bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da hūm̐: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: go ro tsa na'i mchod pa 'bul: rnam shes tshogs brgyad mchod pa 'bul: don snying rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: māṃ sa sha yi mchod pa 'bul: keng rus tshil chen mchod pa 'bul: nang rol sna lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dug lnga dug gsum mchod pa 'bul: snang srid 'khor 'das mchod pa 'bul: ma hā pañca pū tsa ho: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: snang ba yab la stong pa yum: thabs shes dbyer med sbyor ba las: byang sems dkar dmar bde ba'i rgyun: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa 'di: bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: bo dhi tsit+ta pū tsa ho: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman: khyad par rmad byung bdud rtsi 'di: nyon mongs dug lnga gnas gyur cing: ye shes sku lnga grub pa'i rdzas: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: chos nyid stong gsal bhan+dha ru: dug gsum bsgral pa'i rak+ta babs: nyon mongs dug lnga sbyang ba'i phyir:

rak+ta'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: bha ling gtor mchod 'bul ba ni: bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod nang du: bha ling gtor mchod bltams pa la: sha sna snying sna dmar chen brgyan: dza gad phud kyis bran pa 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus rnams: 'dod yon zhen bral ngang du bzhes: ma hā bha lin ta la khā hi: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dug gsum mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dgra bgegs rus ni mar bas zhim: zhe sdang mchod pa bla na med: dgra bgegs khrag ni chang bas zhim: 'dod chags mchod pa bla na med: dgra bgegs sha ni zan bas zhim: gti mug mchod pa bla na med: dug gsum mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: glu bro gar gyi mchod pa ni: glu ni chos nyid stong pa'i glu: gar ni don dam rtogs pa'i gar: bro ni gdug pa 'dul ba'i bro: glu dang gar bro'i mchod pa 'bul: zhes mchod pa rnams 'bul: bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang du: bcom ldan gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje ni: sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar ba la: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs bsgrad: gnam lcags rdo rje nam mkhar gdengs pa ni: snang srid gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags: dug sbrul nag po zhal du gsol ba ni: sa bdag klu gnyan pho nyar 'gyed pa'i rtags: zhal ni bsgrad cing mche ba gtsigs pa ni: snang srid ma lus zhal du gsol ba'i rtags: spyan gsum sdang mig gyen du g.yo ba ni: srid gsum gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags: sma ra kha spu me stag 'phro ba ni: rgyal bsen gdug pa'i tshogs rnams sreg pa'i rtags: smin ma rab 'jigs glog ltar 'khyug pa ni: steng gi lha rnams ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba ni: chos kyi dbyings la 'gyur ba med pa'i rtags:

rigs bdag mi bskyod dbu la brgyan pa ni: dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs mchog yin pa'i rtags: thod pa'i dbu rgyan prog zhu gsol ba ni: dug lnga rnam dag dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rtags: sku stod seng glang g.yang gzhi gsol ba ni: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos rtags: stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris byas pa ni: bdud dang srin po'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: mi mgo skam rlon do shal byas pa ni: ma dag sems can bla med 'dren pa'i rtags: sbrul gyi chun pos sku la brgyan pa ni: ma mo sman gyi tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: 'dab bzang dkar pos sku regs byas pa ni: the'u rang 'byung po'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: dga' bo 'jog po dbu yi thod bcings ni: lha srin sde brgyad ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags: zhabs kyis brkyang bskum 'dor stabs bsgrad pa ni: mu stegs log pa'i bgegs rnams gzir ba'i rtags: sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba ni: 'jig rten 'di na 'gran zla med pa'i rtags: me phung klong na 'gying tshul bzhugs pa ni: phyin ci log pa'i bgegs rnams sreg pa'i rtags: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni: bdud bzhi bcom nas dam sri gnon pa'i rtags: ye shes khyung chen rigs lngas brgyan pa ni: dug lnga bag chags dbyings su dag pa'i rtags: dung skyong bu yis phyag g.yas brgyan pa ni: rje rigs klu yi tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: mtha' yas bu yis phyag g.yon brgyan pa ni: dmangs rigs klu yi tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: pad+ma bu yis zhabs g.yas brgyan pa ni: bram ze klu yi tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: nor rgyas bu yis zhabs g.yon brgyan pa ni: gdol pa klu yi tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i rtags: dkar khra dmar khra gdan du bting ba ni: gza' brgyad klu brgyad bran du khol ba'i rtags: las mkhan khro bcu'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ni: phyogs mtshams kun nas bar chad srung ba'i rtags:
khro mo bzhi yis sgo bzhi srung ba ni: bdud bzhi 'dul zhing las bzhi 'grub pa'i rtags: badz+ra sa ma ya ho: badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ:

zhes bstod do: bzlas pa bya ba ni: bdag nyid gtum po'i thugs ka ru: rdo rje mthing nag tshon gang tsam: lte bar nyi ma'i gdan steng du: hūm̐ mthing nas tsam phyi rol du: rtsa ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pa'i 'od zer khro bo chung: mtshon cha me ri 'phros pa yis: stong gsum gang nas dgra dang bgegs: thams cad bya sgro mes tshig bzhin: gzhob tu btang zhing brlag par gyur: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: gha ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bzla'o: tshogs bya ba ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gsum yi ge 'phros: raṃ las me 'bar dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rlung byung bag chags gtor: khaṃ las chu byung gnyis 'dzin bkrus: byin gyis brlab pa'i yi ge ni: oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ du 'phros: hūm̐ gis rnam rtog mtshan ma sbyangs: āḥyis ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ gyis 'dod yon lha mos brgyan: mchod pa'i gar stabs bsgyur ba yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes gyur cig: hūm̐: gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tshogs rnams: chos kyi dbyings nas spyan 'dren gshegs: bla med dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs la: 'dod yon mchod pas thugs dam bskang: zhes bskang ba'i rim pa gzhan yang bya: de nas tshogs phud gsum bcad la: dang po tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tshogs la: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a mṛ ta: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga lhun grub phyir: ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsi 'di: ye shes gsal ba'i klong du kha raṃ khā hi: zhes bdud rtsi 'bul lo: rak+ta 'bul ba ni: chos nyid stong gsal bhan+dha ru: dmar chen sha khrag ri ltar spungs: gnyis med pad+ma rak+tas gtams: sku gsum lhun grub thob phyir 'bul: ma hā rak+ta la kha raṃ khā hi: tshogs bshags bya ba ni:

hūm̐: sngon byung thog mtha' med pa nas: da lta lus 'di yan chad du: ma rig blo bcos ci byas pa: tshogs kyi mchod pas bshags par bgyi: dgra gzugs ar la gtad pa ni: liṅga la dgug gzhug byas la: bcom ldan gsang bdag skur bzhengs shig: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la babs: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang: zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings: sod cig gtubs shig mā ra ya: nṛ sha trūn mā ra ya hūm̐: zhes pas liṅga bsgral lo: bstab pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: gsang bdag phyag rdor lha tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha rus 'di: zhal du bstab bo kha raṃ khā hi: zhes bstab par bya'o: lhag mchod gtang ba ni: tshogs lhag la chab bran la: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ma sring mkha' 'gro ma: 'bar ma ging lang pho nya'i tshogs: gnas bzang de ni dur khrod 'dzin: gos bzang de ni g.yang gzhi gyon: skyogs bzang de ni bhan+dha thogs: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams ni: o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng gis: a su ra yi brag phug tu: zhing chen bsgyel ba'i gdan stengs su: lce la bdud rtsi bzhag pa dang: dam tshig rdo rje gtad nas kyang: bka' las mi 'da' dam yang bcas: lhag ma'i kha chu 'di bzhes la: phyi rabs dus kyi tha ma la: thar pa thob pa'i lung yang bstan: de phyir lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: la la ling ling e tri ba lin+ta khā hi: zhes lhag gtor btang: bskul ba bya ba ni: hūm̐: dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis: tshur gshegs tshur gshegs rdo rje 'chang: shar gyi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po rnam par rgyal: sku mdog dkar po 'gying bag can: phyag na rang rtags rdo rje gsor: khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang:

byad rnams ma lus 'grol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed: sku mdog ser po bzhad tshul can: phyag na rang rtags rin chen bsnams: khyed la= do nub= yon bdag= gdon rnams= byad rnams= dug rnams= nad rnams= sgrub pa'i= hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po rta mchog dpal: sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro: phyag na rang rtags pad+ma bsnams: khyed la= do nub= yon bdag= gdon rnams= byad rnams= dug rnams= nad rnams= sgrub pa'i= hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas phyogs skyong ni: khro bo chen po bdud rtsi 'khyil: sku mdog ljang gu gtum la rngam: phyag na rang rtags ral gri bsnams: khyed la= do nub= yon bdag= gdon rnams= byad rnams= dug rnams= nad rnams= sgrub pa'i= hūm̐: steng 'og phyogs mtshams phyogs skyong drug: dbyug sngon mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal: rnam rgyal hūm̐ kār stobs po che: rang rtags sku mdog phyag mtshan bsnams: rnal 'byor phrin las bcol ba ni: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs phyir du: gdon rnams ma lus bsrung ba dang: byad rnams ma lus bkrol ba dang: dug rnams ma lus phyung ba dang: nad rnams ma lus phan byed cing: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: ces bskul lo: chad mdo bya ba ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang du: rdo rje 'chang dang gsang bdag phyag rdor gyis: snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus btul: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i bar ma la: dga' rab rdo rje pad+ma thod phreng gis: yang gsang bla med dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: snang srid lha 'dre ma lus dam btags nas: rang rang srog gi snying po phul ba'i tshe: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam:

bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de 'og dus kyi bskal pa'i tha ma la: brag dmar dpal gyi phug ring chen po ru: o rgyan chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: grub pa'i rgyal mo mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gyis: gsang bdag dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: bod kyi lha srin ma lus dam btags nas: rang rang srog gi snying po phul nas kyang: bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: dam rdzas bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rang rang so so'i gnas dang rten la gshegs: zhes chad tho bya'o: brtan ma skyong ba ni: gtor ma phyir khyer la 'di skad do: bh+yo: dam la btags pa'i ma sring brtan ma'i tshogs: rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi yum chen dang: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso: sha med gangs dkar kha rag khyung btsun dang: gser chen mkha' lding rma ri drag mo rgyal: kong btsun de mo btsan la drag mo rtsal: g.yu yi dril bu sman btsun khug chos dang: brtan mar bcas dang skyong ma'i tshogs rnams kyis: dpal gyi pha 'bab gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ma ma hring hring ba lin ta khā hi khā hi: zhes brtan ma bskyang: gtor mnan bya ba ni: dgra yi ling ga bzhag la de steng gtor gzhong kha sbubs la: hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag: nga ni 'jig rten 'dul ba'i gtso: sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab: las kyi pho nyas stong gsum gang: thams cad ma lus skar ltar 'khrugs: dgra bgegs 'byung po rdul du rlog: mnan no gzir ro sa ma ya: rgyal ba'i bstan pa ma rdzogs bar: khyod la thon pa'i skal pa med: phyi ma thar pa thob gyur cig: e laṃ r+nṛ sha trūṃ mā ra ya nan: zhes mnan no: bshags gsol bya ba ni:

hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: mchod pa lhag chad byung ba dang: ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang: ma rig dbang gis dngos ma mthong: dbyer med chos sku'i klong nyid du: bzod par gsol la bshags par bgyi: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: zhes bshags gsol bya'o: hūm̐: gsang bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje'i dbang gis 'dir byon cing: sems can don kun bsgrubs nas kyang: slar yang chos dbyings skye med klong du bsdu: badz+ra mu: zhes ye shes pa gshegs shing dam tshig pa rang la bsdu: rjes kyi bsngo ba smon lam btab pa ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: yang dag cho ga 'di bsngos pas: rdo rje mched lcam 'gro kun rnams: skye med zhing la spyod par shog: smon lam gdab pa ni: gsang sngags dkyil 'khor bsgrubs pa'i mthus: sgo gsum dri ma kun dag nas: rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam rnams: skad cig mi 'bral 'grogs nas kyang: bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mthar phyin nas: tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob par shog: ces smon lam btab bo: bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag yangs pa'i klong: longs sku'i bkra shis mtshan dpe'i 'od 'bar ba: sprul sku'i bkra shis gzhan don mtha' yas shing: sku gsum 'gyur med bkra shis gang lags pa: dam pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog: ces bkra shis gzhan yang bya'o: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: gsang bdag sgrub pa'i las byang 'di: mchod rten sngon po'i rgyud las yang zab tu bton cing bkod pa: dregs pa kun 'dul gyi las byang gnam lcags 'od gyi drwa ba 'di nyid: ye shes mtsho rgyal nyid la gnang: yi ger bris nas rab tu gnas: lho brag dang spyi brag la sbas: ma 'ongs pad+ma nga yi bu: pad+ma'i ming can brtul shugs can: tshig rtsub rta skad cho ler smra: skyes bu de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya:
gsang rgya: dam rgya: na mchacutha: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ sprul sku pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma'o// maṅga laṃ// //
